scope: One explicit finite-dimensional Heisenberg-picture pure-dephasing plus reversible-jump family on M_n(C); not a classification of all quantum detailed-balance semigroups.

reversible_jump_family.Hamiltonian: H=sum_i epsilon_i P_i with simple spectrum
reversible_jump_family.Gibbs_density: rho=sum_i r_i P_i with r_i>0 and sum_i r_i=1
reversible_jump_family.graph: finite undirected graph on energy labels with connected components pi

fixed_point_theorem.fixed_algebra_formula: N_pi={sum_{B in pi} a_B Q_B}, Q_B=sum_{i in B}P_i

detailed_balance_and_covariance.diagonal_reason: the classical generator is self-adjoint in l2(r) by r_i k_ij=r_j k_ji
detailed_balance_and_covariance.offdiagonal_reason: every E_ab, a!=b, is an orthogonal eigenvector with real negative eigenvalue -kappa-(q_a+q_b)/2
detailed_balance_and_covariance.covariance_reason: alpha_t(L_ij) is a phase times L_ij and each Lindblad term is phase invariant

semigroup_limit.formula: E_pi(A)=sum_B Tr(rho Q_B A Q_B)/r_B Q_B
semigroup_limit.isolated_component_boundary: with no edges kappa>0 gives Delta_H; with kappa=0 the identity semigroup fixes M_n

repository_owned: GNS detailed-balance and energy-covariance proof for that family
fixed algebra equals the graph-component partition algebra
exact semigroup limit equals the K97 partition expectation
connected coarse diagonal sharp nonselection boundary

nearby_controls: K97 finite simple-Hamiltonian energy-partition expectation classification
retrieval_duplicate_boundary.new_object_only: an explicit Gibbs-reversible dephasing-plus-jump semigroup whose fixed algebra and norm limit realize every K97 partition, proving graph-relative nonselection

claim_ceiling: Exact fixed-point algebra, GNS detailed balance, energy covariance and semigroup-limit theorem for one explicit finite-dimensional pure-dephasing plus reversible-jump family, with a complete n=3 partition census; no classification of all quantum detailed-balance semigroups and no derivation of the Hamiltonian, Gibbs state, dephasing, graph, energy basis, classicality, Born rule, physical record selection, source dynamics, continuum theory, prediction or verdict.
